column21: Case rate applicable for 25 allowable days. Days 26-90 paid at per diem of $4,627 for non-ICU days and $6,480 for ICU days. Days 91+ are considered post transplant period and will be reimbursed at 65% charges. Pre transplant is reimbursed at 65% of charges. Retransplant within the same admission will be paid a case rate of $166,122, but if re-transplant is during post transplant care (after 91+ from admission and 1 year) reimbursement will be case rate less 20%. If billed charges are less than the case rate + outlier per diems, payment will be 95% of charges. Cadaveric organ and living donor services costs are included in the case rate. If a member's coverage terminates during the service period, payment is lesser of 60% of billed charges or case rate + per diems. If billed charges exceed 375% of the case rate, reimbursement will be 65% of charges for charges above the threshold. High cost drugs in revenue code 343, 344, 636 that have billed charges greater than $5,000 per revenue code will be paid at 50% of charges.
